title: Classification chooses a group
summary: Classification predicts a group label. For this toy example, a threshold is the number where our choice changes.
introduction: Classification predicts a group label. For this toy example, a threshold is the number where our choice changes. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Classification predicts a group label. For this toy example, a threshold is the number where our choice changes.

blocks.title: Classification chooses a group

blocks.text: The output is small large. The threshold is 5. A real classifier might learn a threshold from labelled examples.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Find what happens when size is exactly 5.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A class label is a choice of group; it does not show how certain that choice is.
For more detail later, use this [Machine Learning further reading](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course).
